slides.text: Three questions before any vendor touches client data
slides.voiceover_text: Three questions every owner should ask any vendor before they touch your client data. Skip these and you're handing them the keys.

slides.text: Where is the data stored and who can access it?
slides.voiceover_text: One. Where is the data stored and who can access it? Country. Servers. Staff. Sub-processors. All of it in writing.

slides.text: Is it used to train any model? Get a yes or no
slides.voiceover_text: Two. Is my client data used to train any model? Get a clear yes or no in writing. Vague answer means yes.

slides.text: How fast can you cancel and pull your data out?
slides.voiceover_text: Three. How fast can I cancel? How do I get every piece of my data back? If the answer is complicated, that's your answer.

slides.text: Storage. Training use. Exit. All in writing.
slides.voiceover_text: Storage. Training use. Clean exit. Get those three in writing before you sign anything.
